[[Marshal/Legends|Marshal]] '''Levnis''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Baron/Legends|baron]] who owned a personal [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] named the ''[[Lady Akiko]]''. He was attempting to purchase a [[Kalld'n-class stardrive|''Kalld'n''-class stardrive]]; as only fifty of the drives had been constructed, and forty-three had been accounted for, he turned to [[The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers]] in an effort to locate one.
